app.name: ClaimShield Nexus
app.banner: Synthetic data only. Indicators need human review; they are not findings.

onboarding.title: Welcome to ClaimShield Nexus
onboarding.subtitle: Choose the language you want for the interface and the assistant. You can change it later from the top bar.
onboarding.note: Case evidence and policy text stay in English so that every figure can be checked; the assistant can answer in your language.

dashboard.title: Executive dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What needs a person today, and how the system is learning.
dashboard.empty: No data in this run yet.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.placeholder: Ask about a case, a policy or how this works
chat.confirm: Check what was understood, edit it if needed, then send.
chat.disclaimer: Answers use validated platform facts only. The assistant cannot change anything and gives no medical or legal advice.

hero.title: Your SIU Second Brain.
hero.subtitle: Turn thousands of unexplained claim alerts into evidence-backed investigations.
hero.note: Every figure comes from the current analysis run on synthetic data. Nothing here is live or external.

pipe.signalsSub: Rule, peer, history and network alerts
pipe.caseSub: Ranked by risk, dollars and effort

loop.title: How every decision becomes institutional memory

prov.factHelp: A recorded fact in the claims data
prov.humanHelp: Decided and recorded by a person

outlook.disclaimer: Prioritization signal — not proof of future misconduct.

triad.title: How sure are we, and why
triad.rule: Confidence comes from evidence, never from the risk score.

memory.na: Institutional memory is not available for this case.
memory.why: Why am I seeing this precedent?

ai.title: Grounded explanation
ai.note: Written only from this case’s validated evidence pack. Every sentence cites evidence ids and is checked before you see it. It explains; it never decides.
ai.why: Shown instead of the model’s text

feedback.title: Was the AI help useful?
feedback.comment: Comment (required if you modified or rejected)
feedback.note: Stored for supervisor review. It does not change any rule, score or model by itself.

knowledge.title: Lessons from this closed case
knowledge.secondPerson: A second person must review this draft.
knowledge.note: Approved lessons are shown next to similar future cases. They inform explanations; only the precedent and exception governance can change a score or a rule.

kb.title: Lessons waiting for review
kb.note: Case, feedback, pattern extraction, review, approved knowledge. One person’s feedback never changes a rule or a score.

why.noContra: None was found in the evidence pack.
why.notBecause: Why it stayed below a case
